description:
Read one check from a site's latest crawl_site run (or run_id): what it means, why it matters, how to fix it, which MCP tools fix it, and the affected URLs with evidence, paginated. check_id comes from crawl_site / get_latest_crawl checks[].id.

Billing: free — reads the stored crawl; nothing is fetched.

Inputs:
  site_id  — the AuditAE site id (from list_sites).
  check_id — a check id, e.g. "title_missing" or "broken_internal_link".
  run_id   — optional earlier run (get_latest_crawl history[].run_id); default the latest.
  limit    — items per call, default 25, max 100; offset — pass next_offset.
  compare  — optional 'new' or 'fixed': only the pages that started failing since the previous crawl ('new'), or that failed then and don't now ('fixed': fixed, or the page now errors or redirects; evidence from that crawl), plus vs_previous { from, to, new, fixed }. Link, image and script checks list new items only.
  base_run_id — with compare: the earlier run (history[].run_id); default the crawl this one was compared with.

Returns: { site_id, run_id, check: { id, title, severity, themes, scope, rule, why, fix, fix_tools, semrush_ids }, status: fail|pass|not_run|pending, n, of, items: [{ url, evidence }], total, next_offset, groups?, compare?, vs_previous?, note? }. Page checks list every failing page; site-wide checks one item; duplicate and broken-link checks add their groups on the first call. After fixing, submit_urls with the changed URLs, then crawl_site again to confirm. { error: "run_predates_checks" }: crawled before Site Audit checks; crawl again.

base_run_id.description: With compare: the earlier run to compare with. Default: the crawl this one was compared with.

check_id.description: A check id from crawl_site / get_latest_crawl checks[].id.

compare.description: Only the pages newly failing ('new') or fixed ('fixed') since the previous crawl.

offset.description: Default 0. Use next_offset from the previous answer.

run_id.description: Optional run id. Default: the latest run.

name: get_crawl_issue
title: Get one Site Audit check's affected URLs, evidence and fix
